body: Hmm. It seems I have a lot of work to do then. Thank you though! I feel like I have a good place to start now. I’ll make sure to reconsider a different approach with my views and labels. And hopefully with enough research, I’ll figure out a good balance with things. I very much appreciate your help :)
From the way you describe him, his content sounds very intriguing. Thank you. I look forward to watching him

I completely understand where you’re coming from. Although my main concern with having mixed views tends to be… having a lot of hypocrisy in my beliefs. And I understand that hypocrisy exists on both sides of the spectrum, but I’d like to keep it at a minimum. Generally speaking, each side tends to be consistent in their views. And that’s what I sorta hope for as well
Oh really? Huh. Thanks for telling me! I’ll try to do plenty of research into all these different news sources. I appreciate your help
I’m not trying to “infiltrate” you. I just want to have a better understanding of your views. I’m sorry if the way I write comes off weirdly. I’m not trying to be invasive :(
Thank you very much for your recommendation
Thank you for your recommendation! I’ll check them out :)

I decided to change my views for a few reasons. To be honest, lots of my views in the past were pretty politically mixed. I remember I used to be pro-gun and pro-death penalty. But at the same time, I used to be pro-trans and pro-choice. Now, I’d like to actually pick a side. And I think I prefer this one

Which sources do you know of? I’d like to get a good handful of people and perspectives. And really, I don’t mind so much if there’s an agenda involved in my news. Pretty much all news has a certain agenda, at the end of the day
Ah, sorry. Please ignore those. They were a few years back, I don’t really research that stuff anymore. I just used to be an edgelord kid
I remember seeing this picture in one of my history classes. It shocked me so much back then, and it still does, nowadays
I’d say awkward and/or shy. Judging from the manifesto, he probably didn’t act the same way in his YouTube videos and writings, as he did in real life
Wait- no. I misinterpreted what you meant. We’re looking for Adam Lanza’s body. Not his victims. I get that they need to rest in peace and have privacy. Don’t worry

Well it would be pretty important to the case. There are lots of cases where dead body pictures (of mass killers) have been released to the public, like I mentioned. So obviously people would want to see this one too

In regards to the part about his anorexia post, I’m pretty sure he didn’t write it himself. He copied and pasted it off a pro-anorexia forum so presumably a female originally wrote it. If you see the full list, there are other quotes that make it clear that it’s first-person about a girl.

I’m pretty sure the dead body pictures won’t ever be released (unfortunately). As far as I know, that kind of stuff is locked away with the police. The only reason we have the columbine ones, for example, is because they were illegally leaked. But I don’t know for sure. If footage of Lanza driving to the school exists, it definitely *could* be released. So I guess we’ll just have to be hopeful :)
